newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Healthcare signs French, German deals.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare signs French, German deals.

text.p: Healthcare Technologies Ltd said it has signed long-term exclusive distribution agreements with French and German medical diagnostics marketing companies for distribution of its products in France and Germany.
The two agreements combined call for a first-year minimum order commitment of more than $1 million.

The agreements were signed through the Israeli company's Savyon Diagnostics subsidiary. Under the agreement, Bmd SA of France will distribute Savyon products in France over an initial period of five years with a first-year minimum order commitment of $583,000.
Hain Diagnostika GmbH will distribute Savyon products in Germany over an initial period of three years with a first-year minimum order commitment of $457,000.
Healthcare makes diagnostic testing kits for a variety of diseases and tests for steroids and drug abuse.
